messages:
alex: installing redwoodctl on a headless CI VM and the postinst hangs at an auth prompt. `redwoodctl login` shows "Waiting for authentication..." forever. looks like pkexec invoked during package postinst. anyone seen this?
maya: yes, pkexec in postinst will try to spawn a polkit agent GUI and block on headless systems. check `/var/lib/dpkg/info/redwoodctl.postinst` for a pkexec chown call.
alex: confirmed: `pkexec chown -R $SUDO_USER:$SUDO_USER /home/$SUDO_USER/.redwoodctl` is in postinst. quick workaround in CI: `sudo mkdir -p /home/$USER/.redwoodctl /home/$USER/.local/share/redwoodctl && sudo chown $USER:$USER /home/$USER/.redwoodctl /home/$USER/.local/share/redwoodctl` then login works.
maya: long-term fix: change postinst to avoid pkexec (use runuser/sudo or create dirs as root with correct ownership) and ensure CLI falls back fast to file-based credential store if secret service unavailable. filing an issue.
infra-bot: opened issue #4150: "postinst pkexec blocks headless installs; add console-safe postinst and faster credential-store fallback" assigned to @maya.
